about: Every xterm.js member wmux uses (non-test src/renderer at the wt-wmux-base checkout, @xterm/xterm 6.1.0-beta.336 and its addons) and its status in the Rust front end (crates/oxtty-web). Restored from 0510a7d, where the TypeScript front end reached the old statuses; reasons still describe that front end until each member is redone. An entry whose name is not an API member (DOM, internals, prose) carries `exercisedBy`, a regular expression some test must match, before it may be `supported` (api-checklist.test.mjs).

statuses.todo: Supported by the TypeScript front end at 0510a7d; not yet in the Rust front end.
statuses.unsupported: Not planned; the reason says what replaces it.

init.reason: Loads both WebAssembly modules (engine oxtty.wasm, front end xterm_web_bg.wasm); in Node it reads the files.

Terminal.constructor.reason: crates/oxtty-web Terminal; cols, rows and scrollback are constructor-only like xterm.js.

options.cols.reason: Init-only like xterm.js: a runtime change to another value throws; resize() updates it.

options.rows.reason: Init-only like xterm.js: a runtime change to another value throws; resize() updates it.

options.scrollback.reason: Constructor only: the engine fixes it at creation, a runtime change throws (wmux only reads it).

options.cursorBlink.reason: Renderer option, get/set at runtime: the renderer times the blink itself while focused (xterm.js 6.0 CursorBlinkStateManager timings).

options.cursorStyle.reason: Renderer option, get/set at runtime: block, underline or bar (unless the program set one with DECSCUSR), drawn like @xterm/addon-webgl 6.0; cursorInactiveStyle while unfocused.

options.fontSize.reason: Renderer option, get/set at runtime: re-measures the cell, resizes the screen and fires onDimensionsChange.

options.fontFamily.reason: Renderer option, get/set at runtime: re-measures the cell and rebuilds the glyph atlas; when fonts finish loading the cell is measured again and a loaded fit addon refits.

options.theme.reason: Renderer option, get/set at runtime; also pushed to the engine so OSC 4/10/11/12 queries answer the theme colours, also after a change.

options.minimumContrastRatio.reason: Renderer option: foregrounds are adjusted like @xterm/addon-webgl 6.0 (contrast cache per atlas).

options.scrollbar.reason: showScrollbar builds or removes the .xterm-scrollable-element bar at runtime, width sizes it (xterm.js 14px default); FitAddon keeps the same width free (none without scrollback). showArrows is not drawn.

options.allowProposedApi.reason: Read back (xterm.js default false); no effect: there is no proposed-API gate.

options.scrollOnUserInput.reason: Keys, IME, paste and mouse reports scroll a scrolled-back view to the bottom first (xterm.js CoreService.triggerDataEvent; default true, wmux passes false); replies never do.

options.disableStdin.reason: Drops keys, IME, pastes, mouse reports and replies like xterm.js (CoreService.triggerDataEvent/triggerBinaryEvent); the textarea turns read-only.

options.altClickMovesCursor.reason: Alt+click sends the arrow keys that walk the cursor to the clicked cell (xterm.js 6.1 moveToCellSequence, ported in crates/oxtty-web/src/input/move_to_cell.rs), at the bottom of the scrollback and while the program takes no clicks.

options.vtExtensions.kittyKeyboard.reason: Turns the engine's kitty protocol on (setKittyKeyboard); keys go through oxtty::input's kitty encoder (ported from xterm.js 6.1) with the flags of the last frame. Turning it off drops the pushed flags.

options.vtExtensions.colorSchemeQuery.reason: wmux turns it off for headless parity; the engine has no colour-scheme query reply.

options.vtExtensions.kittySgrBoldFaintCo.reason: wmux turns it off for headless parity; the engine follows xterm.js with it off.

options.macOptionClickForcesSelection.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/input/mouse.rs should_force_selection: on macOS, Option+click is not reported to the program and selects, and Option no longer makes a column selection (xterm.js shouldForceSelection, shouldColumnSelect); selection.test.mjs compares it with xterm.js.

options.linkHandler.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/links.rs, a port of xterm.js OscLinkProvider: OSC 8 links activate, hover and leave through linkHandler with their 1-based range (wrapped links across rows), non-http links only with allowNonHttpProtocols, and without a handler the default confirm-then-open; links.test.mjs compares every callback with xterm.js.

options.screenReaderMode.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/a11y.rs (AccessibilityManager port): the row tree with aria-posinset/setsize refreshed at most once a second, boundary focus scrolling, an aria-live region fed from the cursor's movement between frames (the engine has no per-character stream; lines that scroll out within one frame cannot be read), toggled at runtime; nothing allocated while off. The selectionchange mapping is not ported.

options.windowsPty.reason: Engine option with xterm.js 6.1's rules: blank rows on growth, no reflow before conpty 21376, the conpty wrapping heuristic. Columns a non-reflowing shrink cuts off are dropped (xterm.js keeps them hidden and shows them again when widened), as on the alternate screen.

options.convertEol.reason: Always false (wmux passes false); omit it.

options.windowOptions.reason: Kept as an option and set by the image addon (enableSizeReports); the CSI 14/16/18 t answers it allows come with the parser hooks.

Terminal.open.reason: Builds the xterm.js DOM (.terminal.xterm > .xterm-scrollable-element > .xterm-screen > .xterm-helpers, the wrapper while the scrollbar is shown); opening again moves the element.

Terminal.write.reason: Queued and fed in 12 ms slices like the xterm.js WriteBuffer; the callback runs once the data is parsed.

Terminal.resize.reason: Resizes the engine and fires onResize; listeners may write, resize or dispose.

Terminal.reset.reason: RIS applied at once (scrollback, modes and the pending high surrogate cleared; output a synchronized update holds is applied first); queued writes are parsed afterwards, like xterm.js.

Terminal.refresh.reason: Marks viewport rows for the next frame; onRender reports them, together with the rows the engine changed.

Terminal.dispose.reason: Drops pending writes without their callbacks, removes the element; safe from any listener.

Terminal.loadAddon.reason: Activates the built-in FitAddon (subclasses included) and SearchAddon; absorbs @xterm/addon-webgl, the built-in WebglAddon and @xterm/addon-unicode11; @xterm/addon-search and @xterm/addon-serialize objects throw naming what replaces them; anything else throws.

Terminal.scrollToLine.reason: Scrolls so the line is the top viewport row (engine scrollDisplay), then onScroll; scrollPages and scrollToTop too.

Terminal.rows.reason: Engine rows; the last size after dispose.

Terminal.cols.reason: Engine cols; the last size after dispose.

Terminal.dimensions.reason: IRenderDimensions from the WebGL renderer (CSS and device cell, canvas), undefined before open(); replaces the _core._renderService.dimensions workaround.

Terminal.modes.reason: A new object per read from the engine mode bits (X10 mouse included) and syncPending; reverseWraparoundMode and win32InputMode are always false.

Terminal.unicode.activeVersion.reason: Always "11" (the engine's width tables); setting another version throws.

Terminal.focus.reason: Focuses the hidden textarea (preventScroll); focus and blur set the .focus class, send focus reports in focus events mode, and give the engine the focus it reports on CSI ? 1004 h in place.

Terminal.textarea.reason: The hidden textarea in .xterm-helpers, set by open(); keydown, keypress, input, composition and paste are handled as in xterm.js 6.1 (crates/oxtty-web/src/input).

Terminal.attachCustomKeyEventHandler.reason: Sees every keydown, keypress and keyup first; false stops the key (the ported xterm.js 6.1 arbitration).

Terminal.getSelection.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/selection, a port of xterm.js SelectionService.selectionText over buffer.active: wrapped rows joined, wide characters once, NBSP as spaces; typed trailing spaces are copied and erased cells trimmed like xterm.js (the engine marks typed spaces). Same text as xterm.js in every selection.test.mjs case.

Terminal.clearSelection.reason: xterm.js SelectionService.clearSelection; fires onSelectionChange every time, like xterm.js; does nothing before open().

Terminal.select.reason: xterm.js SelectionService.setSelection (JavaScript numbers, so API input behaves the same); does nothing before open() (xterm.js throws). The built-in SearchAddon selects its match through it.

Terminal.parser.registerOscHandler.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/parser.rs on the engine's parser hooks (setHook while a handler exists, writeUntilHook/pendingHook/finishHook/resume): newest first, true skips the default, a Promise holds the write queue, output before the sequence reaches the host first. A throwing handler counts as false and is rethrown on a later task. OSC 52 still goes through the clipboard option.

Terminal.parser.registerCsiHandler.reason: As registerOscHandler; identifiers are checked with xterm.js's errors. An empty sub-parameter is 0 (xterm.js -1).

Terminal.parser.registerDcsHandler.reason: As registerCsiHandler; the handler gets the whole payload when the sequence ends. The engine does not answer DECRQSS itself, so a handler falling through sends nothing (xterm.js replies).

Terminal.registerLinkProvider.reason: A port of xterm.js Linkifier and LinkProviderService: providers are asked after the OSC 8 links in registration order, synchronously or on a later task; the earliest provider with a link under the mouse wins and later overlapping links are dropped; hover underline (the renderer's "link" layer), pointer cursor and activation on mouseup like xterm.js. A link's decorations are read when it is hovered (later changes are not followed).

Terminal.registerMarker.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/markers.rs on the engine's markers (addMarker/markerLine/takeDisposedMarkers). Unlike xterm.js it returns undefined on the alternate screen and for a line outside the buffer, and ids count per terminal.

Terminal.markers.reason: The live markers, oldest first, [] on the alternate screen; new IMarker objects per read (xterm.js hands out the same ones).

IMarker.id/line/dispose/onDispose.reason: line and isDisposed ask the engine; onDispose fires after the write that dropped the marker is parsed (before its callback), on dispose(), reset, an engine crash and terminal dispose, like xterm.js.

Terminal.onData.reason: Engine replies after each parsed write (input arrives with the input module).

Terminal.onBinary.reason: Fired by default-encoding mouse reports (bytes above 127 are not UTF-8), never by output; disableStdin drops them like xterm.js triggerBinaryEvent.

Terminal.onScroll.reason: Fired when the viewport top line changes after output or scrolling.

Terminal.onRender.reason: Fires after each frame with the rows drawn: rows the engine changed plus refreshed rows, every row after a full redraw.

Terminal.onCursorMove.reason: Fired when the cursor moved after a parsed write.

Terminal.onWriteParsed.reason: Fired after each task that parsed writes.

Terminal.onDimensionsChange.reason: Fires when the cell size changes: font options, fonts that finish loading, a devicePixelRatio change.

Terminal.onSelectionChange.reason: Fires where xterm.js fires, as often: mouse up, API calls, clears by user input, a change of rows, an alternate screen switch, mouse reporting turning on and full resets (twice each, like xterm.js); not when trimming moves or drops the selection. selection.test.mjs counts the events against xterm.js.

buffer.onBufferChange.reason: IEvent property; fires with the new active buffer when the alternate screen is entered or left (once per drain, so a write that enters and leaves fires nothing).

buffer.active.type.reason: 'normal' or 'alternate'; a buffer object keeps its type across screen switches, like xterm.js. A new object per read (no identity), and the inactive buffer reads empty.

buffer.active.cursorX.reason: Engine cursor column; at the right edge it stays on the last column where xterm.js reports cols (the engine keeps the pending wrap to itself).

buffer.active.getLine.reason: A copy of one row (code point and attributes per cell) at call time (xterm.js returns a live view); undefined outside 0..length or for non-integers.

IBufferLine.translateToString.reason: Matches xterm.js (typed spaces are text, erased cells are trimmed: the engine marks typed spaces with Attr.TYPED_SPACE) except that out-of-range columns are clamped (xterm.js pads them with spaces).

IBufferLine.isWrapped.reason: xterm.js meaning: continues the previous line (engine rowWrapped of the line above).

IBufferLine.getCell.reason: A new cell; the reuse argument is accepted and ignored. Wide characters are width 2 with a width-0 right half.

IBufferCell.getChars.reason: As xterm.js, combining marks included; an erased cell reads '' and a typed space ' ' (Attr.TYPED_SPACE).

IBufferCell.getWidth.reason: 2 for a wide character, 0 for its right half, else 1.

IBufferCell.isDim.reason: Engine DIM attribute; isBold, isItalic, isUnderline, isBlink, isInverse, isInvisible and isStrikethrough too.

FitAddon.fit.reason: Built-in FitAddon export (crates/oxtty-web/src/fit.rs, ported from @xterm/addon-fit 0.12); a loaded one refits by itself when the cell size changes. @xterm/addon-fit itself is not accepted.

FitAddon.proposeDimensions.reason: Same formula as @xterm/addon-fit 0.12 (parent size less the element padding and the scrollbar width); undefined before open().

FitAddon.dispose.reason: Detaches the addon; proposeDimensions() is undefined afterwards.

FitAddon subclass (FixedGeometryFitAddon.reason: Extends the built-in FitAddon: loadAddon calls its activate (with a handle on the terminal, not the same JS object), super.fit/proposeDimensions work, and the refit after a cell size change calls its own fit. Its _core._renderService.dimensions read moves to terminal.dimensions.

WebglAddon (load).reason: Absorbed: the WebGL2 renderer is built in (one context per page); @xterm/addon-webgl and the built-in WebglAddon are never activated.

WebglAddon.onContextLoss.reason: Absorbed; never fires because the renderer restores or replaces a lost context itself.

WebglAddon.dispose.reason: Absorbed; no-op (there is no DOM renderer to fall back to).

WebglAddon.clearTextureAtlas.reason: Absorbed; redraws the terminal in full.

Unicode11Addon (load).reason: Absorbed: activate() runs against a stand-in that has only unicode.register and must register version 11.

SearchAddon.findNext/findPrevious/clearD.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/search.rs, a port of @xterm/addon-search 0.17.0-beta.330 over the engine's searchLine (JS string methods and RegExp, no matcher in the wasm): same matches, selection and scrolling, quirks included; decorations go to the renderer's "search" highlight layer (no overview ruler). The match is selected with Terminal.select and the next search starts from getSelectionPosition, as in the addon.

SerializeAddon.serialize.reason: loadAddon throws; Terminal.ansiSnapshot() (engine) replaces it. coldFrame's scrollback:0 + excludeModes variant needs an engine option (later).

WebLinksAddon.reason: Built in (crates/oxtty-web/src/links.rs), a port of @xterm/addon-web-links 0.13.0-beta.330 accepted by loadAddon: the same URL pattern (a JS RegExp, or options.urlRegex), URL check, wrapped-line windows and handler, hover and leave options; links.test.mjs compares it with the real addon. Load this package's WebLinksAddon; the npm addon is refused by loadAddon.

ImageAddon.reason: Rust (crates/oxtty-web/src/image): loadAddon takes the built-in ImageAddon or absorbs @xterm/addon-image; sixel decoded in Rust, PNG/JPEG/GIF by createImageBitmap, tiles in engine cells, page-wide storage limit, WebGL image layer. Supported once the parser hooks route DCS q, OSC 1337 and the addon's CSI handlers to it.

_core._charSizeService.measure/onCharSiz.reason: There is no _core; use onDimensionsChange, and a loaded fit addon refits by itself (charSizeRefit goes away).

_core._renderService.setRenderer/handleR.reason: webglTeardown: there is no DOM renderer fallback; the WebGL renderer restores its context.

_core.coreService.kittyKeyboard.reason: oxtty API: xtermKittyFlags(term) becomes term.kittyKeyboardFlags (the flags the encoder uses, from the last frame) and resetXtermKitty(term) becomes term.resetKittyKeyboard() (both screens, applied at once). Resetting in stream order at OSC 133;A still needs registerOscHandler (later).

_core.coreService.onUserInput.reason: oxtty API: term.onUserInput fires just before onData for keys, IME, paste and mouse reports, never for replies to the program; userInputGate subscribes to it instead.

_core._compositionHelper.reason: deadInputWatchdog reads _isComposing/_isSendingComposition only for a log line and logs '?' without them; the copied CompositionHelper stays internal.

WebglAddon._renderer._gl.reason: Context loss is handled inside the renderer.

WebglAddon._renderer._charAtlas.reason: Atlas health checks belong inside the renderer (atlasGuard goes away).

ImageAddon._handlers.reason: A Map with 'sixel' and 'iip' stand-ins; a decoded sixel goes through handlers.get('sixel').unhook with _dec.width/height and _aborted, so wmux's sixel cap wraps it. Supported with ImageAddon.

DOM .xterm-screen.reason: Built by open(); sized to the canvas.

DOM .xterm-helpers.reason: Built by open() inside .xterm-screen; holds the textarea and the composition view.

DOM .xterm-helper-textarea.reason: Built like xterm.js (class, aria and autocomplete attributes, tabindex 0, read-only with disableStdin); placed on the cursor cell after frames that move the cursor, once the renderer gives a cell size.

DOM .composition-view.reason: The ported CompositionHelper fills it while composing (between LRM marks) and places it at the cursor (style.left/top) with the textarea under it, on every frame and once more a task later.

DOM .xterm-scrollable-element .scrollbar.reason: crates/oxtty-web/src/scrollbar.rs: .xterm-scrollable-element wraps .xterm-screen with .xterm-scrollbar.xterm-vertical > .xterm-slider (the class names xterm.js 6.1.0-beta.336 uses; wmux's .scrollbar/.slider selectors match neither), the same inline sizes, xterm-visible/xterm-invisible/xterm-fade and xterm-active classes; slider drags and track presses scroll the view. No horizontal bar, arrows or shadows; the wheel is the mouse module's.

CSS @xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css.reason: open() injects its own styles; drop the import.

Element reparenting (park and re-append).reason: open() again with another parent moves the element; the renderer keeps drawing.

Synthetic mouse events on .xterm-screen.reason: Mouse reports and selection both listen on the element, so dispatched events (wmux plainDragSelect replays) select and report like real ones; selection.test.mjs dispatches them on both terminals.

write() from inside parser handlers.reason: Queued behind the writes already waiting and parsed after the data being parsed, like xterm.js (parser.rs, terminal.rs drain).
